lines.text: (Several people appear in front of Baldrick, who is sitting in the cool breeze.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's been a while everyone. Considering that you came this far, I guess I was wrong. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Jiscard, my brother. nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, Lord Baldric. Let’s spar next time.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, think about it. It’s been a while since the Shineek kid.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah, it's been a while. Are you having any fun today?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I think it's fun, but I don't know about you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ooh... . It feels like a nuisance.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: And Grandpa Adkina, thank you for last time.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Nope. This was possible because of you.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: And… .
Man, it’s been a while. I thought he would be disappointed if he just came, so I prepared a gift for him. After all, people have to eat meat.
(A cold-looking girl in white clothes gestures, and a large piece of ice falls from the sky.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: How did you know I like meat so you brought me all this?
If Baldrick says he doesn't like meat, Weiss will be surprised.
… I don't believe you don't eat meat... , Baldrick… . It would be like this.
(The girl in white lowers her voice and imitates Vice.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, Miss Io is really good at imitating Vice.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Sure. I can't forget what happened to me. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Instead of calling me uncle or lady anymore, call me by my first name. It's been hundreds of years since I started calling him that out of courtesy to my father.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's already happened. I did it because I was grateful for receiving the elder’s grace. From now on, I’ll just call you Io. Then Medea… I guess I should call it that too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Whoa. I feel more comfortable now. Thank you, uncle. and! Definitely that meat! Share it with people who are indebted to you on a regular basis. This is a mountain goat raised in the clean energy of a snowy field.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And since it was aged with Deborah's ice, it will melt as soon as you put it in your mouth.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow, that sounds delicious.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I sent it to Tartarus so that Shinik could eat it too.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Really? thank you!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm planning to ask Mir to send it to me so that other people won't be offended either. I feel sorry for Adkina. Since you don't eat food... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I also sent it to Miss Medea, but I don't know if she will receive it.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'll tell you. Because he listens to what I say.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Then I'll ask you a favor. Anyway, nice to meet you all. You haven't forgotten me all these years, have you? Look. If I don't die, I'll see you again someday.
(Io smiles brightly and shakes hands with everyone, only to hug Shinik with open arms.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I heard that Shinick unnie is so small and so nice to hold.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's unfair that this happens when I'm just trying to grow taller. Phew, you can't die and be reborn. But Baldrick, why does everyone call me by my name and say I’m a kid?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Huh? Why is that? What's wrong with a kid being a kid?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What's the use of talking about hundreds of years? After all, you're an idiot who can't understand.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Sister, don't worry about that. Everyone in the world knows that you are a fool.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, if Io is like that, then it must be like that, right? But what about Medea?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I think we need some time, Lord Baldric.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What's going on with Medea?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Wait until Medea tells you, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hmm, okay.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then, shall we talk?
(Baldrick raises his hand and extends it towards a certain place.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hey, there's got to be Vice over there. I don't know what he's trying to do, but his energy is growing.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know what you mean, but now is not the time.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I know, grandpa. therefore… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's difficult to explain this at length in words. So, when the time comes, let’s go crush it all together!!
